canonical_neutral.anchor_measurement: Assistant visual registration on the native raster, approximate scene anatomy; not automatic alpha-box centering or subpixel alignment metrology.
canonical_neutral.anchor_basis: Head with short upright mane/ears, short upright torso and feet; side tufted tail excluded from width; two hoof-foot support midpoint.
canonical_neutral.vertical_motion_policy: Consumer places this recorded anchor explicitly and designs any motion. No locomotion, ground shift or body normalization is inferred from this neutral PNG.

calibration.method: Exact reuse of adopted neutral geometry; no new drawing.

landmarks.observations: Manual native homologous head breadth, head-to-torso relation and neck-to-support comparison across sheet. Long cottontail ears and pika ear tips excluded as in canonical. Tail/wing extensions excluded from reference. One common isotropic scale, not nine fitted bbox heights.

canonical_source.direct_input_role: Adopted neutral identity, style, colour and existing visible anatomy reference; reference only, not a pixel-edit target.

calibration.method: Manual native anatomical comparisons across head/face/torso/feet; one isotropic reference per original sheet, no per-pose bbox fit. Values approximate visual registration, not subpixel metrology.
calibration.selection_basis: Manual common original-sheet head and torso scale, approximate anatomical registration awaiting independent QA; preserves intentional gesture deformation.
